newsitem.title: SPAIN: POLL - Spaniards confident of economic future.
newsitem.headline: POLL - Spaniards confident of economic future.

text.p: Spaniards' confidence and optimism on the future of the economy is steadily improving, according to a poll carried out in June by the government's polling institute (CIS) and distributed on Wednesday.
Of those surveyed, 28.7 percent believe the economic situation will be better in one year, compared to 9.2 percent who believe it will be worse.
Those figures are the best in the last six years on an average annual basis, CIS said.

Since the conservative Popular Party took over the government in May 1996, the number of Spaniards who evaluate the economic situation positively has risen by almost 13 points, while the number of those who see it negatively has halved.
"These data do nothing but confirm the growing confidence in the future of the Spanish economy," CIS said.
